items.t: META Rides on Strong Demand in Ad Business: Can It Beat RDDT and SNAP?
items.sum: Meta Platforms' strong ad demand, AI-powered advertising tools, and expanding monetization strengthen its competitive position against Reddit and Snap.

items.t: Anthropic Broke Its $83 IPO Price. What Did Facebook Do Next?
items.sum: Anthropic (ANT) closed at $82.79 on Wednesday, Nov 25. That is 0.3% below its $83 IPO price. It is also 14.8% below its $97.17 first close, only five trading days in. So what happened to other big listings that broke this fast.

items.t: Can PINS's New Microsoft Advertising Deal Boost Its Competitive Edge?
items.sum: Pinterest's Microsoft partnership expands advertising access, leveraging AI and commercial-intent searches to attract brands and boost monetization.

items.t: Snap Sinks 11% in a Week in a “Real Exodus Out of Tech Stocks.” S&P Just Raised Its Credit Rating
items.sum: Key TakeawaysSnap stock is down 11% in the past week, nearly all of it in a Nov. 20 tech selloff that also hit Meta Platforms, The Trade Desk and AppLovin.

items.t: Pinterest Soars 11% as Executive Pay Overhaul Sparks Takeover Speculation
items.sum: Key TakeawaysPinterest shares jumped 11% today after a filing gave its executives more pay protection in a takeover. No buyer has been announced, and the changes look like a move to keep its leadership in place.

items.t: Meta Fell 8% Over the Last 30 Days: Mutiple Wall Street Desks Expect 67% Returns From Here
items.sum: Meta's revenue is surging while its cash flow has gone negative, and a nine-figure legal bill just made things worse. Analysts still see a mispriced giant, but one number in next year's spending plan could decide who is right.
